statements.impact_statement: The official Python 3.12.14 security release records gh-145599 as the CVE-2026-3644 fix, inherited by the official 3.12.15 security release. The checksum-pinned 3.12.15-alpine3.24 image was probed on 2026-10-08: CPython 3.12.15 and Morsel.update/js_output reject control characters.

The official Python 3.12.14 security release records gh-145986 as the CVE-2026-4224 fix, inherited by the official 3.12.15 security release. The checksum-pinned 3.12.15-alpine3.24 image was probed on 2026-10-08: CPython 3.12.15 and pyexpat 2.8.5.

The official Python release announcement records gh-149018 hash-flooding protection in 3.12.14; the 3.12.15 release updates bundled Expat to 2.8.5. The checksum-pinned 3.12.15-alpine3.24 image was probed on 2026-10-08: CPython 3.12.15 and pyexpat 2.8.5 retain the reviewed fix.
